content: यज्ञिय {%a.%} [यज्ञाय हितः घ] .²1 Belonging to or fit for a sacrifice, sacrificial; अथर्ववेदप्रवराः पूगयज्ञियसामगाः <ls>Mb. 1. 70. 40</ls>. .²2 Sacred, holy, divine. .²3 Adorable, worthy of worship. .²4 Devout, pious. .{@-यः@} .²1 A god, deity. .²2 The third or Dvāpara age. .²3 The Udumbara tree. .{@-यम्@} Implements or materials for sacrifice (यज्ञसामग्री); यज्ञियं च कृतं सर्वं पुरुषैः सुसमाहितैः <ls>Rām. 1. 13. 37</ls>.
